role: Optional internal route contracts, not an execution engine or required user interface.

workflows.when: Read or assess a supplied DOI or paper; skip lookup if reliable text is already supplied.
stop_conditions: No full text: restrict claims to actually read material.
Unresolved identity conflict: do not conflate documents.

workflows.when: Inspect an existing VASP calculation or diagnose its failure; input preparation is a separate domain route.
stop_conditions: Parsed energy alone is not convergence evidence.
Missing backend: use an available inspected parser or report blocked, never invent execution.
No automatic resubmission or modification of raw outputs.

workflows.when: Inspect a local scientific table and, if requested and justified, analyze or plot it.
stop_conditions: Unresolved units/design: describe data but defer affected scientific inference.
No silent cleaning or held-out data leakage.
Prediction not requested: do not add a model.
